name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
nativeName: பிரதமர் கிசான் சம்மான் நிதி / പി.എം. കിസാൻ സമ്മാൻ നിധി
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summarySimple: Provides ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts of landholding farmer families.

benefits.frequency: Three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months
benefits.shortSummary: Direct cash assistance of ₹6,000 annually via Aadhaar DBT
benefits.detailedBenefit: Direct income support transferred straight into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of eligible small and marginal farmer families.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Mandatory identity proof linked with mobile number for e-KYC

documents.name: Land Ownership Record (Patta / Chitta / RoR)
documents.description: Proof of agricultural landholding in applicant's name

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Aadhaar-linked active bank account with IFSC code

applicationSteps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in) or visit your nearest CSC / e-Sevai centre.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter your Aadhaar Number and State.
Fill in landholding details (survey number, patta number, area in hectares/acres).
Submit and complete OTP-based or biometric e-KYC.
offlineApplicationCenter: Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Agriculture Department / CSC Center

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
nativeName: பிரதமர் ஊரக வீட்டுவசதி திட்டம் / പി.എം. ആവാസ് യോജന (ഗ്രാമീൺ)
summarySimple: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for construction of a permanent pucca house with basic amenities.

benefits.frequency: Milestone-based installments linked to geo-tagged construction progress
benefits.shortSummary: Direct financial aid up to ₹1.3 Lakh for building a pucca house
benefits.detailedBenefit: Financial grant for building a safe, permanent house with toilet provision and 90-95 days of unskilled labour support under MGNREGS.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof of all adult family members

documents.name: Ration Card (BPL / SECC)
documents.description: Proof of inclusion in rural deprivation list

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Bank account details for DBT fund disbursement

applicationSteps: Contact your Gram Panchayat Secretary or Village Administrative Officer.
Verify your household status in the PMAY-G Beneficiary Awaas+ list.
Submit bank details and land clearance for geo-tagging approval.
offlineApplicationCenter: Gram Panchayat Office / Block Development Office (BDO)

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
nativeName: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு / ആയുഷ്മാൻ ഭാരത് പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ജൻ ആരോഗ്യ യോജന
summarySimple: Free health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary cashless hospitalization.

benefits.frequency: Cashless hospitalization coverage per family annually
benefits.shortSummary: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 Lakh annually in empaneled hospitals
benefits.detailedBenefit: Covers medical exams, treatment, surgery, post-hospitalization expenses, and medicines across over 27,000 empaneled hospitals nationwide.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof of beneficiary

documents.name: Ration Card
documents.description: Family card identifying member eligibility

applicationSteps: Visit any empaneled government or private hospital or nearest CSC centre.
Meet the 'Ayushman Mitra' at the helpdesk.
Provide Aadhaar card and Ration card to verify eligibility and generate your Ayushman Golden Card instantly.
offlineApplicationCenter: Any Empaneled Government / Private Hospital or CSC Center

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
nativeName: பிரதமர் தெருவோர வியாபாரிகள் கடன் திட்டம் / പി.എം. സ്വനിധി
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summarySimple: Collateral-free working capital micro-loans of ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors and small traders.

benefits.frequency: Progressive tranches upon timely digital repayments
benefits.shortSummary: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest rebate
benefits.detailedBenefit: Empowers urban and peri-urban vendors to resume and expand their micro-businesses with low-interest institutional bank credit.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof

documents.name: Certificate of Vending / ID Card
documents.description: Issued by Urban Local Body / Municipality or Letter of Recommendation

documents.name: Bank Account details
documents.description: Account where loan funds will be disbursed

applicationSteps: Visit the PM SVANidhi portal (https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or your Municipality Office.
Select your Urban Local Body and provide your Vending Certificate number.
Choose a preferred lending bank and submit your application.
offlineApplicationCenter: Town Vending Committee / Municipal Corporation / Nationalized Banks

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
nativeName: பிரதமர் விஸ்வகர்மா திட்டம் / പി.എം. വിശ്വകർമ യോജന
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summarySimple: Holistic support for traditional artisans & craftspeople: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, 5-7 days skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and up to ₹3 Lakh loan at 5% interest.

benefits.shortSummary: ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive + low interest business loans
benefits.detailedBenefit: Recognition via PM Vishwakarma Certificate, skill upgradation stipend, modern tool grant, and collateral-free enterprise loan.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity and biometric authentication

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Bank account details

documents.name: Self-Declaration of Trade
documents.description: Declaration of engaging in one of 18 traditional family trades

applicationSteps: Visit the official PM Vishwakarma portal (https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in) via Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete Aadhaar biometric verification and select your registered trade (e.g. Carpenter, Blacksmith, Sculptor, Cobbler, Tailor).
Submit for Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification.
offlineApplicationCenter: Common Service Centre (CSC) / District Industries Centre (DIC)

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
nativeName: அடல் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம் / അടൽ പെൻഷൻ യോജന
authority: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
summarySimple: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 for unorganized sector workers.

benefits.frequency: Guaranteed monthly lifelong pension after 60 years of age
benefits.shortSummary: Guaranteed lifelong monthly pension after age 60
benefits.detailedBenefit: Provides lifelong social security pension to subscriber and spouse, with return of accumulated pension corpus to nominee after demise.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof

documents.name: Savings Bank Account
documents.description: Account with auto-debit facility for monthly contribution

applicationSteps: Visit your savings bank branch or Post Office where you have an active account.
Fill out the APY registration form specifying your desired monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
Ensure sufficient balance in your bank account for monthly auto-debit.
offlineApplicationCenter: Any Commercial Bank / Post Office Branch

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
summarySimple: Monthly basic income grant of ₹1,000 transferred directly into the bank accounts of women heads of households in Tamil Nadu.

benefits.frequency: Monthly direct benefit transfer on the 15th of every month
benefits.shortSummary: ₹1,000 monthly cash assistance directly to women family heads
benefits.detailedBenefit: Empowers women family heads with independent financial dignity, social security, and direct economic support.

documents.name: Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
documents.description: Tamil Nadu digital smart ration card indicating woman as family head

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Applicant's biometric identity proof

documents.name: Electricity Consumer Number
documents.description: Household electricity card indicating annual usage below 3600 units

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Aadhaar-linked active savings account

applicationSteps: Obtain the special application form distributed at your local ration shop / ward camp.
Attend the designated Kalaignar Magalir Urimai special camp in your revenue ward.
Provide Smart Ration card and biometric Aadhaar authentication.
offlineApplicationCenter: Revenue Ward Camp / e-Sevai Centre / Taluk Office

name: Pudhumai Penn Thittam (Moovalur Ramamirtham Higher Education)
nativeName: புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம் (மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் உயர்கல்வித் திட்டம்)
authority: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
summarySimple: ₹1,000 per month financial aid for female students from government schools pursuing higher education degrees, diplomas, or ITI courses.

benefits.frequency: Monthly credit throughout undergraduate degree/diploma duration
benefits.shortSummary: ₹1,000 monthly allowance for girl students during higher education
benefits.detailedBenefit: Aims to prevent female dropout, reduce early marriage, and increase higher education enrollment ratio among girls.

documents.name: School Study Certificate (Classes 6 to 12)
documents.description: Certificate showing continuous study in Tamil Nadu government schools

documents.name: College Admission Proof / ID
documents.description: Proof of current enrollment in recognized college / polytechnic / ITI

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Student's identity proof

documents.name: Student Bank Account Passbook
documents.description: Bank account opened in student's name

applicationSteps: Approach your college Nodal Officer / Principal's office during first semester enrollment.
Submit details through the Pudhumai Penn institutional portal verification.
Once verified by the Social Welfare Department, funds are credited monthly via Aadhaar DBT.
offlineApplicationCenter: College Student Welfare Section / District Social Welfare Office

name: Thamizh Pudhalvan Thittam
summarySimple: ₹1,000 per month financial assistance for boy students who studied in Tamil Nadu government schools (Classes 6 to 12) pursuing higher education.

benefits.frequency: Monthly direct benefit transfer throughout higher studies
benefits.shortSummary: ₹1,000 monthly allowance for boy students pursuing college/diploma
benefits.detailedBenefit: Direct financial incentive to encourage boys from economically weaker families to complete collegiate degrees, polytechnics, or ITI.

documents.name: Government School Study Certificate (6th to 12th)
documents.description: Certificate from headmaster verifying government school education

documents.name: College Bonafide Certificate
documents.description: Proof of active college enrollment

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar number of student

documents.name: Student Bank Passbook
documents.description: Direct bank account for monthly DBT

applicationSteps: Register through your college admission desk and upload EMIS school certificate.
Verify bank account seeded with Aadhaar.
College principal approves list on the state higher education portal.

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
authority: United India Insurance / Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project
summarySimple: Cashless medical insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for over 1,090 surgical procedures and medical treatments.

benefits.frequency: Cashless hospitalization coverage per family annually
benefits.shortSummary: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh in empaneled hospitals across TN
benefits.detailedBenefit: Provides 100% cashless medical coverage, diagnostics, surgery, and intensive care across government and private empaneled hospitals.

documents.name: Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description: Revenue department certificate showing annual income below ₹1.2 Lakh

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof of all family members

applicationSteps: Visit the CMCHIS kiosk at your District Collectorate or Government Headquarters Hospital.
Submit Smart Ration card, Income Certificate, and Aadhaar card.
Get your biometric photo captured and receive your CMCHIS Smart Card on the spot.
offlineApplicationCenter: District Collectorate CMCHIS Kiosk / Govt Hospital Helpdesk

name: LIFE Mission Housing Scheme (Livelihood Inclusion and Financial Empowerment)
authority: Local Self Government Department, Government of Kerala
summarySimple: Financial assistance of ₹4,00,000 to construct safe, secure permanent houses for homeless and landless families across Kerala.

benefits.frequency: 4 staged installments linked to construction milestones (Basement, Lintel, Roof, Completion)
benefits.shortSummary: ₹4 Lakh financial assistance for building a permanent home
benefits.detailedBenefit: Comprehensive housing and livelihood inclusion package providing financial grant to construct durable pucca homes.

documents.name: Ration Card (Non-Priority / Priority BPL)
documents.description: Kerala digital ration card

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Identity proof of family head and members

documents.name: Village Income Certificate
documents.description: Income certificate from Village Officer showing annual income below ₹1 Lakh

documents.name: Land Possession Certificate (Thandapper)
documents.description: Proof of owning at least 3-4 cents of land for house construction

applicationSteps: Apply online through the LIFE Mission portal (https://lifemission.kerala.gov.in) or Akshaya Centre.
Gram Panchayat / Municipality conducts physical field verification of dwelling.
Once approved in the beneficiary list, agreement is executed and funds released in 4 stages.
offlineApplicationCenter: Grama Panchayat / Municipality Office / Akshaya Centre

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
authority: State Health Agency (SHA), Government of Kerala
summarySimple: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare in Kerala.

benefits.frequency: Cashless hospitalization per family per year
benefits.shortSummary: ₹5 Lakh annual cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals across Kerala
benefits.detailedBenefit: Provides cashless hospitalization, day-care treatments, and ICU support for economically vulnerable families in Kerala.

documents.name: Kerala Ration Card (Pink / Yellow Priority)
documents.description: Priority ration card issued by Civil Supplies Department

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar cards of all family members

applicationSteps: Visit your nearest Akshaya Centre or empaneled hospital KASP help desk.
Present your Ration Card and Aadhaar Card to verify inclusion in the SECC / Priority list.
Obtain your digital KASP e-Card for cashless admissions.
offlineApplicationCenter: Empaneled Hospital KASP Helpdesk / Akshaya Centre

name: Subhiksha Keralam Integrated Agriculture Scheme
authority: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare
summarySimple: Input subsidies, seed grants, and financial incentives for fallow land cultivation, vegetable farming, and dairy development in Kerala.

benefits.frequency: Crop-season based input and cultivation incentive
benefits.shortSummary: Subsidies for vegetable farming, fallow land cultivation, and irrigation
benefits.detailedBenefit: Offers free high-yield seeds, solar fencing subsidies, mechanized tools, and interest-free crop loans through primary agricultural credit societies.

documents.name: Land Tax Receipt / Lease Deed
documents.description: Proof of agricultural land ownership or authorized lease

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Applicant identification

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Cooperative / Nationalized Bank account details

applicationSteps: Visit the AIMS portal (https://www.aims.kerala.gov.in) or visit your local Krishi Bhavan.
Register your land details and crop plan with the Agricultural Officer.
Inspect and receive sanctioned subsidies directly in your bank account.
offlineApplicationCenter: Local Krishi Bhavan / Agricultural Field Officer

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
authority: Women and Child Development Department, Karnataka
summarySimple: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 transferred directly to the bank accounts of women heads of households in Karnataka.

benefits.shortSummary: ₹2,000 monthly direct financial assistance to woman head of family
benefits.detailedBenefit: Aims to support women homemakers and empower female heads of households across Karnataka.

documents.name: Ration Card (BPL / APL / AAY)
documents.description: Karnataka Ration card identifying woman as family head

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar card of woman head and husband

documents.name: Aadhaar Seeded Bank Account
documents.description: Bank account linked with NPCI mapper

applicationSteps: Visit Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centers.
Submit Ration Card number and Aadhaar authentication.
Receive SMS confirmation upon successful registration.
offlineApplicationCenter: Grama One / Karnataka One / Bangalore One / Bapuji Seva Kendra

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
authority: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood
summarySimple: Monthly unemployment allowance of ₹3,000 for degree holders and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years.

benefits.frequency: Monthly allowance for up to 24 months
benefits.shortSummary: Monthly unemployment stipend up to ₹3,000 for fresh graduates
benefits.detailedBenefit: Financial bridge support to assist educated youth in Karnataka while searching for employment or preparing for competitive examinations.

documents.name: Degree / Diploma Certificate
documents.description: Marks card and passing certificate from recognized Karnataka institution

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar identification proof

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Aadhaar linked bank account

applicationSteps: Apply online through the Seva Sindhu portal (https://sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).
Upload graduation marks sheet and residential proof in Karnataka.
Monthly self-declaration of unemployment is verified for stipend release.

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
summarySimple: Financial investment support of ₹13,500 per year for farmer families including tenant farmers across Andhra Pradesh.

benefits.shortSummary: ₹13,500 annual input subsidy directly to farmer families
benefits.detailedBenefit: Provides timely financial assistance to agricultural families to purchase quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm inputs.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar proof

documents.name: Pattadar Passbook / CCRC (Tenant)
documents.description: Land record or Crop Cultivator Rights Card

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Aadhaar seeded bank account

applicationSteps: Contact your Village Agriculture Assistant at the Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK).
Verify your landholding and cultivation details.
Display on social audit list for public verification.

name: Jagananna Amma Vodi
summarySimple: Financial incentive of ₹15,000 per year provided to mothers sending their children to school from Class 1 to 12.

benefits.frequency: Annual direct transfer before academic year start
benefits.shortSummary: ₹15,000 annual education financial aid to mothers
benefits.detailedBenefit: Encourages low-income parents to send their children to school with minimum 75% student attendance.

documents.name: Rice Card / White Ration Card
documents.description: Proof of economic status in AP

documents.name: Aadhaar of Mother & Child
documents.description: Identity proofs

documents.name: School Attendance Certificate
documents.description: Proof of active school enrollment with 75% attendance

applicationSteps: School headmaster enrolls child on Childinfo educational portal.
Village / Ward Secretariat verifies mother's bank details and household mapping.
Funds credited directly into mother's savings account.
offlineApplicationCenter: Grama / Ward Secretariat / School Principal Desk

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
authority: Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra
summarySimple: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 (₹18,000/year) transferred directly into the bank accounts of women aged 21-65 in Maharashtra.

benefits.shortSummary: ₹1,500 monthly financial grant directly to eligible women
benefits.detailedBenefit: Provides independent social and economic financial freedom to women from low-income families across Maharashtra.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Aadhaar identification proof

documents.name: Yellow or Orange Ration Card
documents.description: Maharashtra digital ration card

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account

applicationSteps: Apply online through the Nari Shakti Doot App or Aaple Sarkar portal.
Visit Setu Suvidha Kendra or Anganwadi Centre for offline assistance.
Complete biometric Aadhaar e-KYC for approval.
offlineApplicationCenter: Anganwadi Center / Gram Panchayat / Setu Kendra

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Uttar Pradesh
summarySimple: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 provided across 6 developmental milestones from birth to undergraduate education for girl children in UP.

benefits.frequency: Milestone-based installments (Birth, Vaccination, Class 1, 6, 9, and Degree admission)
benefits.shortSummary: ₹25,000 grant across 6 milestones for girl child education & health
benefits.detailedBenefit: Aims to eliminate female foeticide, foster education, and secure health and wellbeing for daughters in Uttar Pradesh.

documents.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
documents.description: Official municipal / hospital birth certificate

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description: Annual household income below ₹3 Lakh

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Parents & Child
documents.description: Identity proofs

documents.name: Joint Bank Passbook
documents.description: Bank account opened in name of mother/girl child

applicationSteps: Visit the official portal (https://mksy.up.gov.in).
Register as Citizen and apply under the specific milestone (Stage 1 to Stage 6).
District Probation Officer verifies records and disburses funds.
offlineApplicationCenter: Block Development Office / District Probation Office / CSC Center
